title: TITLE: A LIVE PILLAGER AND ROBOT FIGHT BEHIND THE MENU
why: His answers Q52 and Q54: behind the title, the scoreboard and the how-to pages, the live map with real pillager-versus-robot combat, no recorded clip, no frame cost. Two fights on the Undercroft floor either side of the menu: the game own pillager and sentry bodies, tracer shots, sparks, a robot that blows up and rolls back in, a pillager that goes down and gets up. Four bodies on a private random generator, so the raid seed and the seed 4242 fingerprint are untouched.
now: Behind the title and the scoreboard a pillager and a robot fight, live.
